name: CiFi
summary: Niche fibre ISP providing Christmas Island Fibre Internet to residents on Christmas Island, partnered with Vocus.

events.details: CIFI PTY LTD ACN 637 574 317 (ABN 93 637 574 317) registered 20 Nov 2019; ASN AS140065 allocated 27 Jan 2020. The operating company is registered in WA (6030, northern Perth) and also holds the business names WHIZZ IT and Norfone; it delivers the CiFi (Christmas Island Fibre) service to Christmas Island.
source: https://abr.business.gov.au/ABN/View?abn=93637574317 (CIFI PTY LTD, ABN active 20 Nov 2019, WA 6030; business names WHIZZ IT, Norfone)
